bullets.text: Enhanced Gaming Experience - **Xbox** introduces new features for Windows gaming, improving control and playability across devices.
AI-Ready Data Strategy - **Microsoft Fabric** evolves data organization, enabling businesses to harness AI effectively.
Unified Data Governance - **Microsoft Purview** enhances data security and governance, crucial for AI-driven operations.
Free Developer Registration - Individual developers can now publish apps on the **Microsoft Store** without fees.
Innovative Copilot+ PCs - **Microsoft** showcases advancements in AI and productivity at IFA 2025 with new PC offerings.
